title_zh: 为街边拍摄选定不挡通行的机位

scenario.label_zh: 街边外景拍摄光线与通道确认
scenario.goal_zh: 核对演员即将到场及开拍安排，选定阴影较少且不占人行道的拍摄位置

context_zh: 虚构摄制组在获准使用的店铺前院内准备外景，保持公共通道畅通。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: The actors will be here shortly. Is everything ready for today's shooting?

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: Almost. That tree casts a shadow over the doorway, so their faces will be dark.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: Could we move the camera onto the sidewalk and film from there?

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: No, that would block people. Our marked filming area is inside the forecourt.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: What about this corner, still inside the marks? The doorway looks brighter from here.

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: Yes, the doorway is clearly lit on the monitor. Let us use that position and keep the public path clear.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll secure the camera here, then we can begin once the actors have rehearsed the entrance.
